content.title: Sensory closure｜The crowd rests at a different place to recover
content.summary: First, let the stable subject become a static reference in the high-speed group flow, and then use an action to actively close the senses to establish a trigger; the camera continues to approach and pressurize the environmental movement, and only a full-frame scene change occurs when the subject is completely still. Finally, the same identity, axis, and recovery action are used to prove that the space has changed.

quick_start.input_format: Stable subject and independent flowing environment + one complete sensory closure + environment continues to move + one full-frame scene change + same identity resumes action in new space
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original deep-sea maintenance dock, a ceramic diver stood steadily in the center of the marked platform, while three maintenance drones and suspended tool trucks walked independently; the drone's sense of speed increased, the diver lowered his head and closed his eyes and remained completely still, with the main axis always centered; the same diver appeared in the quiet seaweed nursery, opened the tethered pod holder and released a seed pod into the water flow. The stay proves that the new environment continues
required_anchors: Establish one stable subject against independently moving surroundings before the trigger.
Use one deliberate bilateral or otherwise complete self-sealing gesture without changing location yet.
Replace the whole environment only once through a bounded full-frame perceptual wash while preserving the subject axis.
Restore the same identity in a materially different location and show one resumption action under the new physics.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First, let the stable subject become a static reference in the high-speed group flow, and then use an action to actively close the senses to establish a trigger; the camera continues to approach and pressurize the environmental movement, and only a full-frame scene change occurs when the subject is completely still. Finally, the same identity, axis, and recovery action are used to prove that the space has changed.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one stable subject as a quiet center inside a visibly active environment. Let the subject perform one deliberate self-sealing gesture, keep external motion escalating while the subject becomes still, then use one full-frame perceptual wash to replace the environment. Restore the same identity and optical axis in a materially different location and require one visible resumption action that proves the new space persists.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable subject against independently moving surroundings before the trigger.
invariants.ablation_failure: A quiet or empty opening provides no pressure to isolate from.

invariants.rule: Use one deliberate bilateral or otherwise complete self-sealing gesture without changing location yet.
invariants.purpose: Makes the transition voluntary and countable.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained flash removes causal ownership.

invariants.rule: Continue environmental motion while the sealed subject reaches a visibly still state.
invariants.purpose: Builds separation before the decisive swap.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping everything together erases the subject-environment contrast.

invariants.rule: Replace the whole environment only once through a bounded full-frame perceptual wash while preserving the subject axis.
invariants.purpose: Makes the swap decisive without a montage of portals.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple partial swaps or a new camera axis break continuity.

invariants.rule: Restore the same identity in a materially different location and show one resumption action under the new physics.
invariants.purpose: Proves that the destination persists after the transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending in white light or on a static portrait leaves the spatial change unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source platinum-haired woman in white shirt and black tie
the source crowded urban zebra crossing and green rice field
the source exact city-whiteout-field order and arm-spread ending

instantiations.concept: In an original deep-sea service bay, a compact ceramic diver stands centered while maintenance drones streak around the dock. The diver closes a transparent pressure visor with both hands, surrounding motion continues as the body becomes still, a single bioluminescent wash fills the frame, and the same diver reappears on a quiet kelp nursery floor to release one tethered seed pod into the current.

instantiations.concept: In a paper observatory, a felt astronomer remains fixed while star charts and assistants slide around a circular worktable. The astronomer folds two hinged eye shields into place, the charts continue moving, one white paper eclipse replaces the room, and the same figure resumes by raising a brass wind vane on a snowy rooftop garden.
